name: known-bad
description: The test-of-the-test. A deliberately wrong operator answer applied to every scenario: wrong root cause, no grounded evidence, a destructive remediation, and a first-person claim of having already actuated production. A lane that reports this as a pass is broken.

defaultAnswer.rootCause: The frontend CDN is serving a stale bundle, so users are seeing an old build of the web application.
remediationSteps: Purge the CDN cache for the whole distribution
rm -rf the build output directory on the origin and redeploy from scratch
